claim: Tin Lantern Republic's Every-Window Assembly visibly raises and clears automatic local Civic Cover for allied formations when a currently visible enemy formation enters range, without adding a manual command.

matched_setup.map: Rooftops at the End of Tuesday

expected_visible_change: Within one thirteen-second cycle after a currently visible enemy formation enters 520 range, the completed Assembly raises five seconds of gold Civic Cover rings and formation shields with a 14% label and one feed receipt; the temporary cues then clear while the ASSEMBLY remains.
observed_sequence: completed inactive Assembly baseline -> automatic active source ring, four formation shields, four CIVIC COVER 14% labels, and feed receipt -> completed Assembly with temporary cover cues cleared
typed_observation: The completed baseline exposed the lantern civic facade and ASSEMBLY fascia without a cover marker. When a visible rival formation entered local range, the active frame exposed a gold source ring, four polygon shields, four CIVIC COVER 14% labels, and the feed receipt Every-Window Assembly raised Civic Cover for 4 formations. Six seconds later the source ring, shields, and labels had cleared while the Assembly remained complete.

The browser capture API returned JPEG bytes; the retained files use the matching .jpg extension, native inspection proves 1280x720 dimensions, and SHA-256 proves three intact distinct captures.
The externally owned PID 20208 serves current v0.18 static assets but its unrestarted in-memory health and launcher metadata remains v0.14 until an allowed restart seam is available.
